title: DeathSwap-Advanced
description: A thrilling minigame plugin where players randomly swap locations! Supports customized rules, scoreboards, and multi-language.
body:
# ☠️ DeathSwap - Advanced Minigame

DeathSwap is a thrilling and strategic minigame where players randomly swap locations at regular intervals. Trap your friends, survive their traps, and be the last one standing!
（プレイヤーが一定間隔でランダムに入れ替わるミニゲームです。罠を仕掛け、相手の罠を生き抜き、最後まで生き残ろう！）

## ✨ Features (特徴)
* **Score/Kill Point System**: Earn points by successfully killing other players with your traps! (キルポイント制対応)
* **Custom Scoreboard**: Real-time beautiful scoreboard showing countdowns and player ranks. (美麗なカスタムスコアボード)
* **Hardcore Mode**: One death means elimination. (一度死んだら脱落のハードコアモード)
* **Multi-Language Support**: Fully supports English and Japanese out of the box! (英語・日本語に完全対応)
* **Highly Customizable**: Easy to change settings via `/ds config` or `config.yml`. (コマンドや設定ファイルから簡単にカスタマイズ可能)

## 🎮 How to Play (遊び方)
1. Join the game with `/ds player join`.
2. Start the game with `/ds start`.
3. Survive and trap other players!

## ⌨️ Commands (コマンド)
* `/ds help` - Show command list.
* `/ds player join/leave/list` - Manage players.
* `/ds config <setting> <value>` - Change game settings in-game.

* バグ報告、お問い合わせはDiscordサーバーよりお問い合わせください。
